Hi Ethan / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the context on Novum's ingestion pipeline and the two main pain points you mentioned: unpredictable per-token costs during spikes, and the lack of an isolation model for regulated workloads. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Recap (very high level):
  • Need: predictable inference economics for customer-facing features (billing, SLAs).
  • Constraint: must support VPC/private deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads.
  • Stakeholders to involve: CTO (systems architecture), Data Platform lead, and a product PM for rollout planning.

- Suggested next step: 30-minute product intro (high-level UX + runtime decisions) followed by an optional 60-minute technical deep-dive with infra folks if that looks useful.

Below are three 30-minute windows (PDT). Please pick one that works for your team or suggest alternatives:
  1) Tue Oct 5 — 10:30–11:00 AM PT
  2) Wed Oct 6 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
  3) Thu Oct 7 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If helpful, you can also grab time directly on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/redwood/jonas-30min

I've attached a short post-discovery notes PDF and a suggested 30-min demo agenda so you can share with the stakeholders.

Goal for the 30 min: align on requirements, confirm the recommended deployment model (hosted vs private), and identify owners for the technical deep-dive.

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed windows for now.

Best,
Jonas
